decisions.reason: The decision limits filler for article-end whitespace to the supplied images; it does not change the magazine's general layout inputs, compilation action, or Flat Plan basis.
The absence of additional filler text does not change the approved Inter typeface, font weight, or readability constraint.
Selecting supplied images instead of extra text as whitespace filler does not change the requirement to remediate image quality with AI when necessary.
The filler-content decision does not affect the restriction reserving red for the cover.
Using only the supplied filler images does not modify the magazine-wide polished, modern, brand-aligned visual-style requirement.
The statement concerns supplemental content for existing article-page whitespace, not the source from which magazine articles must be obtained.
The decision addresses filler available for the current issue and does not cancel or modify the separate guidance requested for future-issue article word counts.
The absence of additional filler text does not affect article category labels, their sources, placement, or presentation.
The source decision does not change which cover-listed articles must be included or the designer's placement responsibility.
The filler-content choice and instruction to send the final PDF do not alter the table-of-contents pagination or completion-timing rules.
Choosing supplied images rather than additional text for article whitespace does not modify the required sharpness of advertisements.
The source decision does not change the requirement for accurate article page numbers on the cover.
